entities.summary: Héctor Miguel Cabrejos Vidarte, O.F.M. is a Peruvian prelate of the Catholic Church who was the Archbishop of Trujillo from 1999 to 2025. He has been a bishop since 1988 and currently heads the Latin American Bishops Council (CELAM).
